widgets_values: Preserving all element positions, details, and composition, only adjusting lighting and shadows and local perspective occlusion achieves native-level blending. Matching scene lighting (light source direction, intensity, color temperature, projection parameters), element highlights and backlights align with the scene, and projections and reflections conform to material properties. Correcting perspective, aligning vanishing and contact points, and seamlessly processing edges at the pixel level, eliminating white edges and seams, and feathering edges for seamless integration. Unifying color and brightness, correcting light and shadow and overlap issues, enhancing lighting consistency, optimizing perspective occlusion, eliminating incongruity, and achieving seamless blending of light, shadow, perspective, and materials.
